summary: Iteration 213 — Automatic Dunning UI testing complete. All new features verified: Run dunning button renders in toolbar, Reminded pills show on invoices with reminders, overdue pills and remind buttons correctly hidden when no invoices are overdue. context_for_next_testing_agent: Automatic Dunning UI is complete. Run dunning button (org-billing-run-dunning-btn) calls POST /api/master-admin/billing/dunning/run and shows info notification when no invoices are overdue. Per-row Remind button (invoice-remind-{number}) only appears on overdue invoices that are not paid/void. Reminded pill (invoice-reminded-{number}) shows count of reminders sent. Overdue pill (invoice-overdue-{number}) shows days overdue. Currently 2 invoices have Reminded ×1 pills (INV-2026-04-0033, INV-2026-04-0028). No invoices are currently overdue so overdue pills and remind buttons are not visible.

new_features: org-billing-run-dunning-btn - Renders in toolbar next to Generate invoice, amber/orange styled with AlarmClock icon
Run dunning click - Calls POST /api/master-admin/billing/dunning/run, shows 'Nothing to chase right now' when no overdue invoices
invoice-overdue-{number} - Pill renders when invoice is past due_at AND not paid/void (0 currently visible - expected)
invoice-reminded-{number} - Pill renders when invoice has reminders[].length > 0 (2 found: INV-2026-04-0033, INV-2026-04-0028)
invoice-remind-{number} - Bell button renders between Send and Record-payment when invoice is overdue AND not paid/void (0 currently visible - expected)
PAID/VOID invoices correctly do NOT show Remind button or overdue pill

mocked_api_note: Resend email service may be in test mode (RESEND_API_KEY). Email may not actually deliver - UI shows info notification with share URL regardless. This is intentional and not a bug.
